name: machinetrack-backend
description: Firebase backend (Firestore rules, indexes, Cloud Functions, emulators) for MachineTrack

scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-machinetrack
scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix functions test && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-machinetrack "node --test tests/functions.test.js"
